name: Enthalpy v0.4.4
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.4

## Fixed

- Runs first Sync setup in the background so that one long desktop request cannot stop it.
- Shows the current setup stage while Enthalpy checks, encrypts, uploads, verifies, and activates the workspace.
- Recovers from temporary desktop connection errors and reports a safe, stage-specific error when setup stops.
- Prevents two first-time Sync setup operations from running at the same time.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS Apple Silicon.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic review is complete.
- Windows Sync enrollment remains disabled.
